messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — rehearsing the co-hosted demo + marketplace listing next Wed. Need final lead-routing + webinar capture mapping. Who can confirm CRM mapping?

Ajay Kapoor: I can take this. Is HubSpot still the plan? We set up a webhook months ago to create contacts with property `origin: partner-marketplace`.

Tess Gallagher: Yes HubSpot. Also want to lock UTM conventions for blog + demo CTA: utm_source=partnername, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=cloud-marketplace. Keep values lowercase.

Sam O'Neill: For webinar capture, do we route straight to SDR queue or assign to Partner AE when partner matches? My preference: SDR by default, AE for named partner deals. @Maria?

Maria Chen: SDR queue for initial triage. Partner rule: if `partner=CloudBridge` then owner=AE_CloudBridge; else owner=SDR_Marketing. Partner contract requires lead share email within 48h.

PartnerOps Bot: Reminder: partner contract requires lead share email within 48h. Reference: https://redwood.company/partner-ops/lead-share :exclamation: (automated)

Ajay Kapoor: I'll push a draft HubSpot workflow today. Example payload for the webhook: 
```
POST /webhooks/hubspot
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "origin": "partner-marketplace",
  "partner": "CloudBridge",
  "utm_source": "cloudbridge",
  "utm_campaign": "cloud-marketplace-wk12"
}
```
I'll add logic to set `owner` based on `partner` and a `lead_age` SLA email trigger.

Tess Gallagher: :thumbsup: I'll update the blog CTA and webinar registration form to include hidden fields: `partner=CloudBridge`, `utm_campaign=cloud-marketplace-wk12`, `referrer=marketplace_listing`. Will coordinate with design for button copy.

Sam O'Neill: Can we also add a hidden field `first_seen_model=redwood-dedicated` on the registration form for segmentation? Not required but will help later.

Maria Chen: Good idea, Sam. Also: benchmark narrative landing page should surface the cost/latency highlights as a one-liner at top, then a short FAQ. Copy owner @Tess — make the FAQ answer: how we measured, hardware used, variance. Keep it light for marketing.

Tess Gallagher: Copy. Draft landing + blog post by EOD Tuesday. I’ll post a doc link in this thread when ready.

Sam O'Neill: Rehearsal slot request — Wed 10:00am PT. Who can join for a run-through and smoke test of lead flows?

Ajay Kapoor: I can do Wed 10am PT.

Sam O'Neill: Me too.

Maria Chen: I’ll be there. After rehearsal I’ll run a smoke test hitting the HubSpot webhook and confirm leads show up with the right properties and owners.

PartnerOps Bot: Event created: "CloudBridge co-host demo rehearsal" — Wed 10:00am PT. Attendees: Maria Chen, Ajay Kapoor, Tess Gallagher, Sam O'Neill.

Tess Gallagher: Cool — small checklist for rehearsal: 1) registration + hidden fields populated, 2) webhook fires, 3) owner routing, 4) partner lead-share email, 5) landing page copy QA. I’ll put it in the doc.

Maria Chen: Perfect. Quick ask: Ajay, can you add a test case where partner is blank to ensure default SDR routing?

Ajay Kapoor: Yep — will include `partner=null` and `utm_source=organic` cases.

Sam O'Neill: If all looks good we can schedule the public blog + marketplace listing for Thurs morning and webinar invite Fri.

Maria Chen: Agreed. Thanks team — post the doc link and I’ll mark this thread for follow-up after rehearsal.
